subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession(reason?)` become a supported after-compaction-only plugin contract whose successful return acknowledges a deferred request rather than completion of the reset?
rationale: This adds a new exported plugin capability and defines its availability, failure, and completion semantics; tests can validate an implementation, but only maintainers can approve the permanent public contract.

options.title: Approve the scoped contract
options.body: Accept the current-session, successful-compaction-only, model-unlocked API after its deferred semantics are documented and real rotation proof is supplied.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Do not export the method on plugin hook contexts and instead provide the needed behavior through an owner-specific compaction or context-engine integration.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped contract
recommendation.body: Accept the current-session, successful-compaction-only, model-unlocked API after its deferred semantics are documented and real rotation proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to both embedded compaction behavior and the exported plugin hook surface.
